# Crayon Roofing & Structures — Sales Call Knowledge Base (auto-distilled)

## Corpus summary

This corpus is a large batch of raw call recordings, but only a minority are genuine sales/enquiry calls. The majority are internal-operations chatter: Diwali gift-distribution coordination, payment/outstanding-bill follow-ups, vehicle/loading/dispatch coordination, production-floor clarifications ("47 kg-ல மாத்துங்க", "L flash மட்டும் ஓட்டுங்க"), and office logistics. Genuine sales material is scattered across ~35-40 calls: inbound roofing-sheet enquiries (cold database calls made by Crayon's own telecallers), a few dealer/fabricator repeat-order calls with detailed sheet-length specifications, screw/welding-rod dealer negotiations, and 1-2 strategic calls about expanding dealer/hub network in Tamil Nadu. Given the mix, this KB is built strictly from the sales-relevant portions; volume of clean "textbook" sales calls is modest, so conclusions are kept close to what is actually said rather than generalized.

## Products & brand ladder

**Core product: Metal Roofing Sheets** (color-coated, profile/trapezoidal roofing sheets) — factory at Manali, Andarkuppam check post, Chennai.
- **JSW Color On Plus** — flagship brand, thickness options 0.45mm / 0.47mm / 0.50mm / 0.60mm. Colors: Sky Blue, Off White, Royal Blue, Terracotta/Red, Grey, Dark Green ("Kali Shelt Green"), Half White (9002).
- **JSW Pragathi / Pragati** — premium tier, slightly higher priced than Color On Plus.
- **JSW Radiance / Silver-On** — other JSW sub-brands; sales reps note "Radiance எல்லாம் இருக்க வாய்ப்பில்லை" (limited availability) in some thicknesses.
- **Asian / Asian Indradhanush (Force)** — lower-cost alternative brand, sold as "Indira Dhanush" with AZ70GSM, ISI mark, used when customer wants cheaper option ("rate குறைச்சு கேட்டு வாங்குவேன்").
- Accessories off the same coil line: **L-flash, ridge, gutter, barge board, crimp/cutter pieces, bend sheets** — all quoted by custom diagram/measurement.

**PUFF Panels (sandwich panels)** — roof & wall cladding, thickness 30/40/50mm, made at a *separate* factory (not Manali normal-roofing line). Reps explicitly tell customers: "இங்க normal metal roofings தான் இருக்கு... வேற factory-ல தான் sir puff-ஓட இதெல்லாம் இருக்கு."

**Polycarbonate / FRP sheets (Lexon brand)** — Clear/transparent, thickness 1.5mm, 1.8mm, 2mm standard; 3mm/4mm/6mm/10mm are special/limited runs needing minimum quantity. Standard max length = **15 feet**; beyond that not possible on standard machine.

**Hardware / fasteners**
- **Tata Agri self-drilling screws** — various sizes: 1 inch, 2 inch (50/55mm), M8 (55mm full-thread), rust-free variants.
- **Welding rods (Tata brand, plus a cheaper "Rasi" alternative)** — sold in cartons/packets with monthly volume schemes.
- **MS Channels (JSW brand, 125/65)** — structural item occasionally enquired.
- **GI sheets** — customers sometimes ask, but reps clarify: "நம்ம GI sheet இல்ல sir, metal roofing sheet தான் பண்ணிட்டு இருக்கோம்."

**Explicitly NOT stocked** (reps redirect or decline): UPVC sheets, liner sheets ("நம்ம இதுல பண்ணவே இல்லையே"), MS corrugated sheets, tile-profile machines (customer told to check with Amar/Everlast for tile profiling).
